sanskrit: apād ita ud u naś citratamo mahīm bharṣad dyumatīm indrahūtim | panyasīṁ dhītiṁ daivyasya yāmañ janasya rātiṁ vanate sudānuḥ ||
english: Hither hath come, most brilliant, he who shall bestow on us great, glorious, Indra-invoked bounty; worthy of praise is the thought along the divine path — the bounteous one wins the gift for the people.

sanskrit: dūrāc cid ā vasato asya karṇā ghoṣād indrasya tanyati bruvāṇaḥ | eyam enaṁ devahūtir vavṛtyān madrya1g indram iyam ṛcyamānā ||
english: Even from afar, dwelling there, his ears resound with the roar of Indra as men proclaim him; may this invocation of the gods turn Indra here, may this hymn of praise draw him joyfully nigh.

sanskrit: taṁ vo dhiyā paramayā purājām ajaram indram abhy anūṣy arkaiḥ | brahmā ca giro dadhire sam asmin mahāṁś ca stomo adhi vardhad indre ||
english: Him, the ancient, the undecaying Indra, I celebrate with songs by the loftiest thought; priests and hymns have set their prayers on him, and a great laudation swells yet more upon Indra.

sanskrit: vardhād yaṁ yajña uta soma indraṁ vardhād brahma gira ukthā ca manma | vardhāhainam uṣaso yāmann aktor vardhān māsāḥ śarado dyāva indram ||
english: May sacrifice and Soma magnify Indra, may sacred prayer, hymns, and devotion magnify him; may the dawns at their going, the nights, magnify him; may months, autumns, and days magnify Indra.

sanskrit: evā jajñānaṁ sahase asāmi vāvṛdhānaṁ rādhase ca śrutāya | mahām ugram avase vipra nūnam ā vivāsema vṛtratūryeṣu ||
english: Thus, O sage, him born for might, grown mighty for glory and fame — the great, the fierce one — let us now win to our aid in the strivings against Vṛtra.

sanskrit: mandrasya kaver divyasya vahner vipramanmano vacanasya madhvaḥ | apā nas tasya sacanasya deveṣo yuvasva gṛṇate goagrāḥ ||
english: Of the gladdening sage, the divine conveyor, whose thoughts are those of a wise man, whose speech is sweet — O God, yoke for the worshipper the gift of cows foremost, of his companionable bounty.

sanskrit: ayam uśānaḥ pary adrim usrā ṛtadhītibhir ṛtayug yujānaḥ | rujad arugṇaṁ vi valasya sānum paṇīṁr vacobhir abhi yodhad indraḥ ||
english: Desiring, he yoked the dawns around the rock with thoughts of holy order, joining them in holy yoking; Indra broke open what had not been broken — the ridge of Vala — and drove back the Paṇis with words.

sanskrit: ayaṁ dyotayad adyuto vy aktūn doṣā vastoḥ śarada indur indra | imaṁ ketum adadhur nū cid ahnāṁ śucijanmana uṣasaś cakāra ||
english: He, the drop of Soma, O Indra, illumes the unseen, scatters the nights and days of autumn; the days set this as their bright banner — he, whose birth is pure, made the dawns.

sanskrit: ayaṁ rocayad aruco rucāno 'yaṁ vāsayad vy ṛtena pūrvīḥ | ayam īyata ṛtayugbhir aśvaiḥ svarvid ā nābhinā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
english: He shining made bright what was lightless; he with holy order arrayed the many dawns; he moves with teams of steeds yoked by sacred rite — the hub-finder who fills mankind with light of heaven.

sanskrit: nū gṛṇāno gṛṇate pratna rājann iṣaḥ pinva vasudeyāya pūrvīḥ | apa oṣadhīr aviṣā vanāni gā arvato nṝn ṛcase rirīhi ||
english: Now, ancient King, praised by the praising one, swell forth many refreshments for the bestowal of wealth; release without harm the plants, the forests, the kine, horses, and men for the hymn.

sanskrit: indra piba tubhyaṁ suto madāyāva sya harī vi mucā sakhāyā | uta pra gāya gaṇa ā niṣadyāthā yajñāya gṛṇate vayo dhāḥ ||
english: O Indra, drink — the Soma is pressed for you to gladden you; unyoke your two bay horses, your companions; sit down amid the singing company, and so grant strength to the sacrifice of the worshipper.

sanskrit: asya piba yasya jajñāna indra madāya kratve apibo virapśin | tam u te gāvo nara āpo adir induṁ sam ahyan pītaye sam asmai ||
english: Drink of this, O Indra, of that very one which, from thy birth, O bountiful, thou hast drunk for exhilaration and for wisdom; the cows, the men, the waters, the stone have all pressed this drop together for thee to drink, together for him.

sanskrit: samiddhe agnau suta indra soma ā tvā vahantu harayo vahiṣṭhāḥ | tvāyatā manasā johavīmīndrā yāhi suvitāya mahe naḥ ||
english: The fire is kindled, the Soma pressed, O Indra; let the best-drawing bays bring thee hither; with a heart intent upon thee I call thee earnestly — O Indra, come for our great well-being.

sanskrit: ā yāhi śaśvad uśatā yayāthendra mahā manasā somapeya m | upa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā no 'thā te yajñas tanve3 vayo dhāt ||
english: Come as thou hast always come, with eager will, O Indra, with a great mind to drink the Soma; hear these our prayers, and then may the sacrifice grant strength to thy body.

sanskrit: yad indra divi pārye yad ṛdhag yad vā sve sadane yatra vāsi | ato no yajñam avase niyutvān sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ ||
english: Whether thou art in heaven at the festival, or elsewhere, or in thine own dwelling, wherever thou abidest — from there, with thy team, in accord, O lover of song, protect our sacrifice with the Maruts.

sanskrit: aheḻamāna upa yāhi yajñaṁ tubhyam pavanta indavaḥ sutāsaḥ | gāvo na vajrin svam oko acchendrā gahi prathamo yajñiyānām ||
english: Come without anger to the sacrifice; the pressed drops flow purified for thee; as kine to their own stall, O wielder of the bolt, come, O Indra, foremost of those worthy of worship.

sanskrit: yā te kākut sukṛtā yā variṣṭhā yayā śaśvat pibasi madhva ūrmim | tayā pāhi pra te adhvaryur asthāt saṁ te vajro vartatām indra gavyuḥ ||
english: With that palate of thine so well-made and most excellent, wherewith thou dost ever drink the wave of sweetness — with that protect us; thine adhvaryu priest hath stood forth; may thy bolt, O Indra, whirl forth to win the kine.

sanskrit: eṣa drapso vṛṣabho viśvarūpa indrāya vṛṣṇe sam akāri somaḥ | etam piba harivaḥ sthātar ugra yasyeṣiṣe pradivi yas te annam ||
english: This drop, this bull of all forms, this Soma hath been prepared for Indra the mighty; drink this, O lord of bays, thou who standest firm, fierce one, that which thou hast desired from of old, which is thy food.

sanskrit: sutaḥ somo asutād indra vasyān ayaṁ śreyāñ cikituṣe raṇāya | etaṁ titirva upa yāhi yajñaṁ tena viśvās taviṣīr ā pṛṇasva ||
english: The pressed Soma, O Indra, is better than the unpressed; this is more excellent for the discerning, for delight; eager to cross over, come to this sacrifice; with it fill all thy powers.

sanskrit: hvayāmasi tvendra yāhy arvāṅ araṁ te somas tanve bhavāti | śatakrato mādayasvā suteṣu prāsmām̐ ava pṛtanāsu pra vikṣu ||
english: We call thee, O Indra; come hither; the Soma shall be ready for thy body; O hundred-powered one, exhilarate thyself with the pressed drinks, and lead us forward, protect us in the battles.

sanskrit: praty asmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara | araṁgamāya jagmaye 'paścāddaghvane nare ||
english: Bring all things to him who yearns, who knows all, who comes readily, who comes forth, the man who is never left behind.

sanskrit: em enaṁ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam | amātrebhir ṛjīṣiṇam indraṁ sutebhir indubhiḥ ||
english: Come, meet him with the Somas — him the foremost soma-drinker, Indra the mighty, with immeasurable strength, with the pressed drops and the juices.

sanskrit: yadī sutebhir indubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha | vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣat taṁ-tam id eṣate ||
english: If ye propitiate him with pressed drops, with juices, with Somas, the wise one knows all things; boldly he goes after each in turn.

sanskrit: asmā-asmā id andhaso 'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam | kuvit samasya jenyasya śardhato 'bhiśaster avaспarat ||
english: For him, for him alone, O adhvaryu, bring forth the pressed drink of the Soma; may he perhaps ward off the abuse of the whole arrogant, noble host.

sanskrit: yasya tyac chambaram made divodāsāya randhayaḥ | ayaṁ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
english: In whose exhilaration thou didst subdue that Śambara for Divodāsa — this is that very Soma, O Indra, pressed; drink it.

sanskrit: yasya tīvrasutam madaṁ madhyam antaṁ ca rakṣase | ayaṁ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
english: Whose fierce-pressed exhilarating drink thou dost guard at its middle and its end — this is that very Soma, O Indra, pressed; drink it.

sanskrit: yasya gā antar aśmano made dṛḻhā avāsṛjaḥ | ayaṁ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
english: In whose exhilaration thou didst release the cows that were fast within the rock — this is that very Soma, O Indra, pressed; drink it.

sanskrit: yasya mandāno andhaso māghonaṁ dadhiṣe śavaḥ | ayaṁ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
english: Exhilarated by whose drink thou dost take on the might of a generous lord — this is that very Soma, O Indra, pressed; drink it.

sanskrit: yo rayivo rayiṁtamo yo dyumnair dyumnavattamaḥ | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
english: He who is most rich among the rich, most glorious among the glorious — the Soma is pressed, that, O Indra, is thine exhilaration, O lord of self-sustaining strength.

sanskrit: yaḥ śagmas tuviśagma te rāyo dāmā matīnām | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
english: That which is capable, most greatly capable, the bestower of wealth, of the thoughts of men — the Soma is pressed, that, O Indra, is thine exhilaration, O lord of self-sustaining strength.

sanskrit: yena vṛddho na śavasā turo na svābhir ūtibhiḥ | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
english: By which, grown great, like one swift and powerful, with thine own aids — the Soma is pressed, that, O Indra, is thine exhilaration, O lord of self-sustaining strength.

sanskrit: tyam u vo aprahaṇaṁ gṛṇīṣe śavasas patim | indraṁ viśvāsāhaṁ naram maṁhiṣṭhaṁ viśvacarṣaṇim ||
english: Him I celebrate for you — the irresistible lord of might, Indra, the conqueror of all, the foremost of heroes, the beholder of all races of men.

sanskrit: yaṁ vardhayantīd giraḥ patiṁ turasya rādhasaḥ | tam in nv asya rodasī devī śuṣmaṁ saparyataḥ ||
english: Him whom hymns do magnify — the lord of swift bounty — both divine world-halves, heaven and earth, now attend with reverence his vigour.

sanskrit: tad va ukthasya barhaṇendrāyopastṛṇīṣaṇi | vipo na yasyo utayo vi yad rohanti sakṣitaḥ ||
english: For you I strew the laud-seat with the greatness of the hymn for Indra — whose aids grow upward like shoots of a wise man, thickly springing in the same abode.

sanskrit: avidad dakṣam mitro navīyān papāno devebhyo vasyo acait | sasavān staulābhir dhautarībhir uruṣyā pāyur abhavat sakhibhyaḥ ||
english: Mitra, ever young, drinking in, found the ability, and went forth better toward the gods; having won with the woollen strainers, the cleansing vessels, he became the broad protector, the guardian for his companions.

sanskrit: ṛtasya pathi vedhā apāyi śriye manāṁsi devāso akran | dadhāno nāma maho vacobhir vapur dṛśaye venyo vy āvaḥ ||
english: On the path of holy order the wise one was drunk to beauty; the gods stirred their minds; bearing the name of the great one through words, the lovely one revealed his form to sight.

sanskrit: dyumattamaṁ dakṣaṁ dhehy asme sedhā janānām pūrvīr arātīḥ ||  varṣīyo vayaḥ kṛṇuhi śacībhir dhanasya sātāv asmām̐ aviḍḍhi ||
english: Place in us the most brilliant power; drive away the many enmities of people; with thy powers make our vigour greater in the winning of wealth — aid us.

sanskrit: indra tubhyam in maghavann abhūma vayaṁ dātre harivo mā vi venaḥ | nakir āpir dadṛśe martrayā kim aṅga radhracodanaṁ tvāhuḥ ||
english: O Indra, O Maghavan, we have become thine alone in giving, O lord of bays; be not estranged; no kinsman hath been seen in mortal man — why then do they call thee the furtherer of the weak?

sanskrit: mā jasvane vṛṣabha no rarīthā mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma | pūrvīṣ ṭa indra niṣṣidho janeṣu jahy asuṣvīn pra vṛhāpṛṇataḥ ||
english: O bull, do not give us over to destruction; may we not come to harm in the friendship of thee, the wealthy; many are thy sittings among the peoples, O Indra — slay those who press not the Soma; root out the ungiven.

sanskrit: ud abraṇīva stanayann iyartīndro rādhāṁsy aśvyāni gavyā | tvam asi pradivas kārudhāyā mā tvādāmāna ā dabhan maghona ḥ ||
english: Roaring like storm-clouds, Indra sets in motion the wealth of horses and kine; thou art from of old the sustainer of the singers — let not those who take from thee ensnare the generous one.

sanskrit: adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānām indrāya bhara sa hy asya rājā | yaḥ pūrvyābhir uta nūtanābhir gīrbhir vāvṛdhe gṛṇatām ṛṣīṇām ||
english: O adhvaryu, hero, offer forth the great pressed draughts for Indra, for he is its king; he who hath grown great through old and new hymns of the singing seers.

sanskrit: asya made puru varpāṁsi vidvān indro vṛtrāṇy apratī jaghāna | tam u pra hoṣi madhuma ntam asmai somaṁ vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhy ai ||
english: In this drink's exhilaration, knowing its many forms, Indra smote the Vṛtras that resisted; offer forth to him this sweet Soma to drink for the hero, the broad-cheeked one.

sanskrit: pātā sutam indro astu somaṁ hantā vṛtraṁ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ | gantā yajñam parāvataś cid acchā vasur dhīnām avitā kārudhāyāḥ ||
english: May Indra be the drinker of the pressed Soma; may he be the smiter of Vṛtra with his bolt while gladdened; may he come from far to the sacrifice — the wealthy one, the guardian of prayers, the sustainer of poets.

sanskrit: idaṁ tyat pātram indrapānam indrasya priyam amṛtam apāyi | matsad yathā saumanasāya devaṁ vy a1smad dveṣo yuyavad vy aṁhaḥ ||
english: This cup, this vessel of Indra's drinking, dear to Indra, immortal, hath been drunk; may it gladden the god for benevolence, driving far from us hatred and distress.

sanskrit: enā mandāno jahi śūra śatrūñ jāmim ajāmim maghavann amitrān | abhiṣeṇām̐ abhy ā3dediśānān parāca indra pra mṛṇā jahī ca ||
english: Exhilarated by this, O hero, slay the enemies — kinsmen or strangers, O Maghavan, the foes; those who array their troops against us, O Indra, crush them as they turn away, smite and slay them.

sanskrit: āsu ṣmā ṇo maghavann indra pṛtsv a1smabhyaṁ mahi varivaḥ sugaṁ kaḥ | apāṁ tokasya tanayasya jeṣa indra sūrīn kṛṇuhi smā no ardham ||
english: In these battles, O Maghavan, O Indra, make wide and easy room for us; win offspring of water and progeny, O Indra, and make our patrons our allies.

sanskrit: ā tvā harayo vṛṣaṇo yujānā vṛṣarathāso vṛṣaraśmayo 'tyāḥ | asmattāñco vṛṣaṇo vajravāho vṛṣṇe madāya suyujo vahantu ||
english: Let the bullish bays, being yoked, the bull-chariot, bull-reined, vigorous coursers, draw thee hither — the vigorous ones, bolt-bearing, well-yoked for the exhilaration of the mighty one.

sanskrit: ā te vṛṣan vṛṣaṇo droṇam asthur ghṛtapruṣo normayo madantaḥ ||  indra pra tubhyaṁ vṛṣabhiḥ sutānāṁ vṛṣṇe bharanti vṛṣabhāya somam ||
english: The bulls, the ghee-dripping, exhilarating waves have filled thy vessel, O bull; O Indra, they bear to thee the bull-like Soma of the pressed drops, to thee the mighty, the bull.

sanskrit: vṛṣāsi divo vṛṣabhaḥ pṛthivyā vṛṣā sindhūnāṁ vṛṣabhaḥ stiyānām | vṛṣṇe ta indur vṛṣabha pīpāya svādū raso madhupeyau varāya ||
english: Thou art the bull of heaven, the bull of earth, the bull of the rivers, the bull of the standing waters; for thee the mighty, O bull, the drop hath swelled — the sweet juice, delightful to drink, for the best one.

sanskrit: ayaṁ devaḥ sahasā jāyamāna indreṇa yujā paṇim astabhāyat | ayaṁ svasya pitur āyudhānīndur amuṣṇād aśivasya māyāḥ ||
english: This god, born with force, stayed the Paṇi with Indra as his ally; this very drop stole the weapons of his own father and the tricks of the malign one.

sanskrit: ayam akṛṇod uṣasaḥ supatnīr ayaṁ sūrye adadhāj jyotir antaḥ | ayaṁ tridhātu divi rocaneṣu triteṣu vindad amṛtaṁ nigūḻham ||
english: He made the dawns good consorts; he placed the light within the sun; he with threefold nature in the luminous realms of heaven, in the places of Trita, found the hidden immortal.

sanskrit: ayaṁ dyāvāpṛthivī vi ṣkabhāyad ayaṁ ratham ayunak saptaraśmim | ayaṁ goṣu śacyā pakvaṁ antaḥ somo dādhāra daśayantraṁ utsam ||
english: He propped apart heaven and earth; he yoked the seven-reined chariot; Soma with skill held the cooked ripeness within the kine, and the spring with ten pressings.

sanskrit: ya ānayat parāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṁ yadum | indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā ||
english: He who with good guidance brought Turvaśa and Yadu from afar — that Indra is our young friend.

sanskrit: avipre cid vayo dadhad anāśunā cid arvatā | indro jetā hitaṁ dhanam ||
english: Even with a non-inspired singer, even with a horse that is not swift, Indra is the winner of the set-out prize.

sanskrit: mahīr asya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīr uta praśastayaḥ | nāsya kṣīyanta ūtayaḥ ||
english: Great are his leadings forth, and his praises are many; his aids never diminish.

sanskrit: sakhāyo brahmavāhase 'rcata pra ca gāyata | sa hi naḥ pramatir mahī ||
english: O friends, sing praise and sing forth to him who carries the prayer; for he is our great wisdom.

sanskrit: tvam ekasya vṛtrahann avitā dvayor asi | utedṛśe yathā vayam ||
english: Thou, O Vṛtra-slayer, art the helper of the single man, and of the two together; even for such as we are.

sanskrit: nayasīd v ati dviṣaḥ kṛṇoṣy ukthaśaṁsinaḥ | nṛbhiḥ suvīra ucyase ||
english: Thou dost indeed lead past enemies; thou makest those who recite the lauds; thou art called most heroic among men.

sanskrit: brahmāṇam brahmavāhasaṁ gīrbhiḥ sakhāyam ṛgmiyam | gāṁ na dohase huve ||
english: I call for milking, as a cow, the prayer-bearer who carries the prayer, the companion worthy of hymns, with praises.

sanskrit: yasya viśvāni hastayo ūcur vasūni ni dvitā | vīrasya pṛtanāṣahaḥ ||
english: In whose two hands all goods have been placed in double — of the hero, the overpowerer of armies.

sanskrit: vi dṛḻhāni cid adrivo janānāṁ śacīpate | vṛha māyā anānata ||
english: O wielder of the stone, O lord of power, break apart even the firm things of men; tear out the tricks of those who do not bow.

sanskrit: tam u tvā satya somapā indra vājānām pate | ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ ||
english: Thee, indeed, O true Soma-drinker, O Indra, lord of prizes, we, desirous of glory, do call.

sanskrit: tam u tvā yaḥ purāsitha yo vā nūnaṁ hite dhane | havyaḥ sa śrudhī havam ||
english: Thee who wert of old, or who art now when the prize is set — thee who art to be invoked — hear the invocation.

sanskrit: dhībhir arvadbhir arvato vājām̐ indra śravāyyān | tvayā jeṣma hitaṁ dhanam ||
english: With swift thoughts, with swift horses, O Indra, the glorious prizes — by thy help may we win the set-out wealth.

sanskrit: abhūr u vīra girvaṇo mahāṁ indra dhane hite | bhare vitantasāyyaḥ ||
english: Thou didst become, O hero, lover of song, great Indra, when the prize is set — most worthy of stretching oneself in the fray.

sanskrit: yā ta ūtir amitrahan makṣūjavastamāsati | tayā no hinuhī ratham ||
english: That swiftest, most rapid aid of thine, O smiter of enemies — with that urge forward our chariot.

sanskrit: sa rathena rathītamo 'smākenābhiyugvanā | jeṣi jiṣṇo hitaṁ dhanam ||
english: As the best charioteer with our chariot that presses on in the yoke — do thou win the set-out prize, O Conqueror.

sanskrit: ya ekait tam u ṣṭuhi kṛṣṭīnāṁ vicarṣaṇiḥ | patir jajñe vṛṣakratuḥ ||
english: Him who is the sole one — praise him, the wide-beholding one of peoples; the lord was born with bull-like purpose.

sanskrit: yo gṛṇatām id āsithāpir ūtī śivaḥ sakhā | sa tvaṁ na indra mṛḻaya ||
english: Thou who wert the kinsman of the worshippers, the auspicious friend in aid — thou, as such, O Indra, be gracious to us.

sanskrit: dhiṣva vajraṁ gabhasty o rakṣohatyāya vajrivaḥ | sāsahīṣṭhā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
english: Take the bolt in thy arm, O wielder of the bolt, for the slaying of demons; prevail and overcome against the rivals.

sanskrit: pratnaṁ rayīṇāṁ yujaṁ sakhāyaṁ kīricodanam | brahmavāhastama ṁ huve ||
english: I call the foremost bearer of prayer, the ancient companion of riches, the stimulator of the praiser.

sanskrit: sa hi viśvāni pārthivām̐ eko vasūni patyate | girvaṇastamo adhriguḥ ||
english: For he alone rules over all earthly goods — the foremost lover of song, the unresisted one.

sanskrit: sa no niyudbhir ā pṛṇa kāmaṁ vājebhir aśvibhiḥ | gomadbhir gopate dhṛṣat ||
english: O lord of kine, fill boldly our desire with teams, with prizes, with horses, with gifts of cattle.

sanskrit: tad vo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane | śaṁ yad gave na śākine ||
english: Sing this aloud at the pressing, companionably, to the much-invoked, the mighty one — which is a good thing like to a powerful bull.

sanskrit: na ghā vasur ni yamate dānaṁ vājasya gomataḥ | yat sīm upa śravad giraḥ ||
english: The bounteous one never withholds the gift of the prize-wealth rich in kine when hymns reach him.

sanskrit: kuvit sasya pra hi vrajaṁ gomantaṁ dasyuhā gamat | śacībhir apa no varat ||
english: May the Dasyu-slayer go forth to the rich cow-pen thereof, and with his powers turn toward us.

sanskrit: imā u tvā śatakrato 'bhi pra ṇonuvur giraḥ | indra vatsaṁ na mātaraḥ ||
english: O hundred-powered one, these hymns call loudly after thee, O Indra, as mothers after a calf.

sanskrit: dūṇāśaṁ sakhyaṁ tava gaur asi vīra gavyate | aśvo aśvāyate bhava ||
english: Thy friendship is hard to abandon; thou art a cow for him who seeks kine, O hero; be a horse for him who seeks horses.

sanskrit: sa mandasvā hy andhaso rādhase tanvā mahe | na stotāraṁ nide karaḥ ||
english: Exhilarate thyself with the Soma-drink for bounty, for the great body; do not subject the praiser to blame.

sanskrit: imā u tvā sute-sute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ | vatsaṁ gāvo na dhenavaḥ ||
english: These hymns seek thee at every pressing, O lover of song, as milch cows seek the calf.

sanskrit: purūtamam purūṇāṁ stotṝṇāṁ vivāci | vājebhir vājayatām ||
english: Most bountiful among the many, the much-praised — among the praisers, with prizes, for those who desire prizes.

sanskrit: asmākam indra bhūtu te stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ | asmān rāye mahe hinu ||
english: May our laud be the most bearer-forward, the most intimate to thee, O Indra; urge us on toward great wealth.

sanskrit: adhi bṛbuḥ paṇīnāṁ varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhann asthāt | uruḥ kakṣo na gāṅgyaḥ ||
english: Bṛbu hath stood upon the Paṇis' highest summit — wide-armpitted as a river's flood.

sanskrit: yasya vāyor iva dravad bhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī | sadyo dānāya maṁhate ||
english: He whose auspicious gift, thousandfold, runs swift as wind — he is bountiful for immediate giving.

sanskrit: tat su no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ | bṛbuṁ sahasradātamaṁ sūriṁ sahasrasātamam ||
english: This well the Ārya singers, all the bards, always proclaim for us — Bṛbu, the giver of thousands, the patron who wins thousands.

sanskrit: tvām id dhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ | tvāṁ vṛtreṣv indra satpatiṁ naras tvāṁ kāṣṭhāsv arvataḥ ||
english: Thee alone, O Indra, we bards invoke for the winning of the prize; thee, the true lord, in the battles with the Vṛtras do men call upon; thee for the horses at the race.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ naś citra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā mahsatāvāno adrivaḥ | gām aśvaṁ rathyam indra saṁ kira satrā vājaṁ na jigyuṣe ||
english: Thou, O glorious one, bolt in hand, bold and much-praised, O stone-wielder — pour together for us, O Indra, cattle, horses, chariot-wealth, all as if for one who hath won the prize.

sanskrit: yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇir indraṁ taṁ hūmahe vayam | sahasramuṣka tuvīnṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe ||
english: Him who overcomes all, the wide-beholding Indra, we call upon; O thou of a thousand strengths, of vast heroism, O true lord — be for our increase in battles.

sanskrit: bādhasejānān vṛṣabheva manyunā ghṛṣau mīḻha ṛcīṣama | asmākam bodhy avitā mahādhane tanūṣv apsu sūrye ||
english: Thou pressest men back like a bull in fury, showering down riches, O Ṛcīṣama; be our protector in the great contest, for our bodies, in the waters, in the sun.

sanskrit: indra jyeṣṭhaṁ na ā bharam̐ ojiṣṭham papuri śravaḥ | yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ ||
english: O Indra, bring to us the foremost, the most powerful, the full-famous glory — that by which, O glorious bolt-handed one, thou hast filled both world-halves, O beautiful-jawed one.

sanskrit: tvām ugram avase carṣaṇīsahaṁ rājan deveṣu hūmahe | viśvā su no vithuṙā pibdanā vaso 'mitrān suṣahān kṛdhi ||
english: Thee, O King, the mighty one, the overcomer of races, among the gods we invoke for aid; make, O wealthy one, all our tottering enemies easy to overcome.

sanskrit: yad indra nāhuṣīṣv am̐ ojo nṛmṇaṁ ca kṛṣṭiṣu | yad vā pañca kṣitīnāṁ dyumnam ā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṁsyā ||
english: Whatever might and heroic strength, O Indra, is among the Nāhuṣas and in the tribes, or the glory of the five peoples — bring all of it, all manly powers, together.

sanskrit: yad vā tṛkṣau maghavan druhy āv ā jane yat pūrau kac ca vṛṣṇyam | asmabhyaṁ tad rirīhi saṁ nṛṣāhye 'mitrān pṛtsu turvaṇe ||
english: Whatever might there is in the Tṛkṣu, in the Druhyu tribe, O Maghavan, or among the Pūrus — all that virile power flow toward us in the hero-overcoming of foes in battle.

sanskrit: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṁ trivarūthaṁ svastimat | chardir yaccha maghayadbhyaś ca mahyaṁ ca yāvayā didyum ebhyaḥ ||
english: O Indra, a threefold shelter, a threefold protection, well-prospering — grant a sheltering covering to the generous and to me; ward off the flame from them.

sanskrit: ye gavyatā manasā śatrum ādabhur abhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā | adha smā no maghavann indra girvaṇas tanūpā antamo bhava ||
english: Those who with a cattle-seeking mind have seized the enemy and boldly assail him — then, O Maghavan, O Indra, lover of song, become the most intimate guardian of our bodies.

sanskrit: adha smā no vṛdhe bhavendra nāyam avā yudhi | yad antarikṣe patayanti parṇino didyavas tigmamūrdhānaḥ ||
english: Then be for our increase, O Indra, here in battle, give us strength when feathered arrows, sharp-pointed flames, fly through the atmosphere.

sanskrit: yatra śūrāsas tanvo vitanvate priyā śarmā pitṝṇām | adha smā yaccha tanve3 tane ca chardir acittaṁ yāvaya dveṣaḥ ||
english: Where heroes spread wide their bodies, seeking the dear shelter of the ancestors — there grant a covering for body and for offspring; ward off unforeseen enmity.

sanskrit: yad indra sarge arvataś codayāse mahādhane | asamane adhvani vṛjine pathi śyenām̐ iva śravasyataḥ ||
english: When thou dost urge on the horses at the start in the great contest, O Indra, along the uneven road, along the crooked path, like hawks eager for fame.

sanskrit: sindhūṁr iva pravaṇa āśuyā yato yadi klośam anu ṣvaṇi | ā ye vayo na varvṛtaty āmiṣi gṛbhītā bāhvor gavi ||
english: As rushing swiftly downhill like rivers when one calls out at a cry — those who wheel about like birds toward the prey, with the prize cow grasped in their arms.

sanskrit: svāduṣ kilāyaṁ madhumas̐ utāyaṁ tīvraḥ kilāyaṁ rasavāṁs utāyam | uto nv a1sya papivāṁsam indraṁ na kaś cana sahata āhaveṣu ||
english: Sweet indeed is this Soma, and rich in honey; sharp indeed is it, and full of juice; and Indra who hath drunk of it — verily none can overcome him in battles.

sanskrit: ayaṁ svādur iha madiṣṭha āsa yasyendro vṛtrahatye mamāda | purūṇi yaś cyautnā śambarasya vi navatiṁ nava ca dehyo3 han ||
english: This is the sweetest, the most exhilarating one here, by which Indra was gladdened in the slaying of Vṛtra; he who smashed the many machinations of Śambara, who struck down ninety and nine strongholds.

sanskrit: ayam me pīta ud iyarti vācam ayam manīṣām uśatīṁ ajīgaḥ | ayaṁ ṣaḻ urvīr amamīta dhīro na yābhyo bhuvanaṁ kac canāre ||
english: This, drunk by me, stirs up speech; this hath set in motion the yearning thought; this wise one measured out the six broad expanses beyond which no being stands far off.

sanskrit: ayaṁ sa yo varimaṇam pṛthivyā varṣmāṇaṁ divo akṛṇod ayaṁ saḥ | ayaṁ pīyūṣaṁ tisṛṣu pravatsuh somo dādhāro rv a1ntarikṣam ||
english: He is the one who made the breadth of earth and the height of heaven; he is the very one; Soma hath upheld the wide atmosphere, the beestings-milk on the three downward slopes.

sanskrit: ayaṁ vidac citradṛśīkam arṇaḥ śukrasadmanām uṣasām anīke | ayam mahān mahatā skambhaneṇod dyām astabhnad vṛṣabho marutvān ||
english: He found the bright-visioned flood, the company of the bright-dwelling dawns; this bull accompanied by Maruts, with a great prop, propped up the sky.

sanskrit: dhṛṣat piba kalaśe somam indra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām | mādhyaṁdine savana ā vṛṣasva rayisthāno rayim asmāsu dhehi ||
english: Boldly drink the Soma from the vessel, O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, hero, in the muster of riches; at the midday pressing pour thyself out, O repository of wealth — place wealth in us.

sanskrit: indra pra ṇaḥ puraeteva paśya pra no naya prataraṁ vasyo accha | bhavā supāro atipārayo no bhavā sunītir uta vāmanītiḥ ||
english: O Indra, look upon us like one who goes before; lead us further on toward the better; be a good ferryman, carrying us across; be a good guide and also a guide of the dwarf.

sanskrit: uruṁ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān svarva j jyotir abhayaṁ svasti | ṛṣvā ta indra sthavira sya bāhū upa stheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā ||
english: Knowing all, lead us to a wide world, to heavenly light, free from fear and filled with well-being; may we come to rest under thy great, lofty, ancient arms as shelters, O Indra.

sanskrit: variṣṭhe na indra vandure dhā vahiṣṭhayoḥ śatāvann aśvayor ā | iṣam ā vakṣīṣāṁ varṣiṣṭhām mā nas tārīn maghavan rāyo aryaḥ ||
english: Place us, O Indra, O hundred-powered one, in the best chariot seat, on the best two horses; carry our highest refreshment — let not the stranger, O Maghavan, surpass us in riches.

sanskrit: indra mṛḻa mahyaṁ jīvātum iccha codaya dhiyam ayaso na dhārām | yat kiṁ cāhaṁ tvāyur idaṁ vadāmi taj juṣasva kṛdhi mā devavantam ||
english: O Indra, be gracious; seek life for me; urge my thought like the edge of iron; whatever I, devoted to thee, say here — take delight in it; make me one who has the gods.

sanskrit: trātāram indram avitāram indraṁ have-have suhavaṁ śūram indram | hvayāmi śakram puruhūtam indraṁ svasti no maghavā dhātv indraḥ ||
english: I invoke Indra the protector, Indra the helper, Indra the easy to invoke in every call, Indra the hero; I call the mighty Indra, the much-invoked — may Indra Maghavan grant us well-being.

sanskrit: indraḥ sutrāmā svavām̐ avobhiḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ | bādhatāṁ dveṣo abhayaṁ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
english: May Indra, the good protector, self-dependent with his aids, all-knowing, be truly gracious; may he thrust back enmity, may he create fearlessness — may we be lords of heroic strength.

sanskrit: tasya vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma | sa sutrāmā svavām̐ indro asme ārāc cid dveṣaḥ sanutar yuyotu ||
english: May we be in the favour and in the auspicious benevolence of him, the adorable one; may that Indra, the good protector, self-dependent, ward away enmity from us ever so far off.

sanskrit: ava tve indra pravato normir giro brahmāṇi niyuto dhavante | urū na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇy apo gā vajrin yuvase sam indūn ||
english: Toward thee, O Indra, as down a slope, the waves of hymns and prayers rush onward with their teams; as a wide bounty, the many pressings — thou dost yoke together, O bolt-wielder, the waters, the cows, and the drops.

sanskrit: ka īṁ stavat kaḥ pṛṇāt ko yajāte yad ugram in maghavā viśvahāvet | pādāv iva praharan anyam-anyaṁ kṛṇoti pūrvam aparaṁ śacībhiḥ ||
english: Who shall praise him, who give to him, who sacrifice, when the mighty Maghavan calls everyone? Striking one against another like two feet alternately, with his powers he makes one first, the other last.

sanskrit: śṛṇve vīra ugram-ugraṁ damāyann anyam-anyam atinenīyamānaḥ | edhamānadviḻ ubhayas ya rājā coṣkūyate viśa indro manuṣyān ||
english: The hero is heard — taming the fierce and ferocious, passing by one and then another; Indra, king of both the growing and the waning, craving like fire, consumes human folk.

sanskrit: parā pūrvvṣāṁ sakhyā vṛṇakti vitarturāṇo aparebhir eti | anānubhūtīr avadhūnvānaḥ pūrvīr indraḥ śaradas tartarīti ||
english: He rejects the friendships of former ones, passing forward, associating with later ones; shaking off never-yet-experienced things, Indra passes through many autumns.

sanskrit: rūpaṁ-rūpaṁ pratirūpo babhūva tad asya rūpam praticakṣaṇāya | indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hy asya haraya ś śatā daśa ||
english: He became a counter-image of every form — that is his form for the perception thereof; Indra moves in many forms through his māyās; for his bay horses are yoked, a thousand and ten.

sanskrit: yujāno haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭeha rājati | ko viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣa āsata utāsīneṣu sūriṣu ||
english: Having yoked the golden horses to the chariot, Tvaṣṭṛ shines widely here; who forever shall sit on the side of enemies, and among those who sit as patrons?

sanskrit: agavyūti kṣetram āganma devā urvī satī bhūmir aṁhūraṇābhūt | bṛhaspate pra cikitsā gaviṣṭāv itthā sate jaritara indra panthām ||
english: We have come, O gods, to a land without cattle-pasture; the earth, though wide, hath become confining; O Bṛhaspati, discern the path in the quest for kine — show the praiser his path thus, O Indra.

sanskrit: dive-dive sadṛśīr anyam ardhaṁ kṛṣṇā asedad apa sadmano jāḥ ||  ahan dāsā vṛṣabho vasnayanto davraje varcanaṁ śambaraṁ ca ||
english: Day by day, at one and the same time, the dark ones occupied the other half; they drove away the offspring from the home; the bull slew the Dāsas who were bartering — Varcana and Śambara in the enclosed fold.

sanskrit: prastokaṁ in nu rādhasa sta indra daśa kośayīr daśa vājino 'dāt | divodāsād atithigvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaraṁ vasu praty agrabhīṣma ||
english: Even a little indeed of the bounty — O Indra, he gave ten purses and ten steeds; from Divodāsa's liberality, from the bounty of Atithigva, we have received the goods captured from Śambara.

sanskrit: daśāśvān daśa kośān daśa vastrādhibhojanā | daśo hiraṇyapiṇḍān divodāsād asāniṣam ||
english: Ten horses, ten purses, ten garments with extra portions of food, ten lumps of gold — these I received from Divodāsa.

sanskrit: daśa rathān praṣṭimataḥ śataṁ gā atharvabhyaḥ | aśvataḥ pāyave 'dāt ||
english: Ten chariots with front-horses, a hundred cows to the Atharvans — Aśvattha gave to Pāyu.

sanskrit: mahi rādho viśvajanyaṁ dadhānān bharadvājān sārñjayo abhy ayaṣṭa ||
english: Sārñjaya worshipped the Bharadvājas, who possessed the great bounty dear to all peoples.

sanskrit: vanaspate vīḻvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ | gobhiḥ saṁnaddho asi vīḻayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
english: O Lord of the forest, mayst thou be of firm limb, our companion who carries forward, of good heroes; bound with cowhide thou art — make thyself firm; may thy charioteer win the conquering prizes.

sanskrit: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary oja udbhṛtaṁ vanaspatibhyaḥ pary ābhṛtaṁ sahaḥ | apām ojmānam pari gobhir āvṛtam indrasya vajraṁ haviṣā rathaṁ yaja ||
english: The power raised up from heaven and earth, the might brought from the forest trees, the vigour of the waters wrapped round with the cowhides — worship with oblation Indra's bolt, the chariot.

sanskrit: indrasya vajro marutām anīkam mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ | semāṁ no havyadātiṁ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
english: O divine chariot, the bolt of Indra, the face of the Maruts, the womb of Mitra, the navel of Varuṇa — pleased with our presentation of oblations, receive the offerings.

sanskrit: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyāṁ purutrā te manutāṁ viṣṭhitaṁ jagat | sa dundubhe sajūr indreṇa devair dūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
english: Let the earth resound and the heaven, O Drum; widely let all the world know thy station; thou, O war-drum, in accord with Indra and the gods, drive away the enemies from afar, ever farther.

sanskrit: ā krandaya balam ojo na ā dhā niḥ ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ | apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭir asi vīḻayasva ||
english: Roar out, set force and vigour in us, thunder forth, driving away misfortunes; breathe away, O war-drum, ill-omen from here — thou art the fist of Indra; make thyself firm.

sanskrit: āmūr aja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumad dundubhir vādadīti | sam aśvaparṇāś caranti no naro 'smākam indra rathino jayantu ||
english: Drive back those cows, make them turn back; the drum with its signal sounds out; let the horse-winged arrows fly on our behalf, O Indra — may our warriors with their chariots be victorious.
